Name: Nicknames for Npcs
Author: undare
Description:
[b][color=#93c47d][size=5]About[/size][/color]
[size=4]After you make the changes on the content file, this will change the [color=#a4c2f4]display name[/color] of the npc on the [color=#f9cb9c]dialogue boxes[/color] and [color=#f9cb9c]relationship window[/color].[/size]
[size=4]It won´t change dialogue or events, and it wont mess up events, as this [color=#dd7e6b]doesn´t[/color] change the "Id-name" of the npc.[/size]

[size=4]Not to be confused with [/size][color=#c27ba0][size=3]Jonqora[/size][/color][size=4]´s [/size][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6489?tab=files&file_id=29344]Custom Spouse Nicknames[/url]﻿[/size] ([size=3]That changes how npcs call your farmer.[/size])

[size=4]It plays well with the event command "ChangeName". (You still target the id-name, and not the visual name)[/size]



[color=#f6b26b][size=5]Usage[/size][/color]
[size=4]Inside this mod folder you will need to open the "content.json" file and edit the npc name to one of your liking and save.
They are marked with a comment marked with a comment for easy search.
(I use [color=#93c47d]Notepad+[/color])
[/size]
[size=4]Then, change its "config.json" option to "[color=#a2c4c9]true[/color]". (On either, the config file or on the [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿[size=4] screen if you have it installed.)[/size]
[size=4](As a reminder, the config file is generated after you launch the game for the first time with this mod installed.)[/size]



[size=5][color=#ffd966]Example[/color][/size]
[size=4]If i want to change the nickname for "Alex" to "BigBoy",[/size]


-I go to the content.json
-Find the field "11:" and change its value
-Then save

//////////////////////
{
"LogName": "Alex Nickname",   ///Alex
"Action": "EditData",
"Target": "Data/NPCDispositions",
"Fields": {
"Alex": {
11: "Bigboy", // <----- Nickname Change the value between the "" And set the Alex value to true in the config or mcn menu.
},
  },
"When":
{
"ModActive": "true",
"Alex": "true"
},
},
[b]//////////////////////
[/b]

[size=4]then i need to either:
[/size]
[size=4]-Go to the config file and set "Alex" to "true"[/size]
[size=4]or[/size]
[size=4]-if you have [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿[size=4], you can just check the box in the "Alex" field.[/size]

[size=4]By defaul, all the options are set to "[color=#f9cb9c]false[/color]".[/size]
[size=4]This is because other mods may change other npcs´s visual names or id names. So you can be "Selective" on wich one you want active.


[color=#dd7e6b]Minor Issue[/color] :
Long names cause the words to go outside of the dialogue box. (As you can see in the last screenshot)
So maybe keep it at 14 characters or less.[/size][/b]
